finalText:
**The build passes now.** You were right, two real bugs hid in the noise.

1. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`. The bump renamed it `retryCount`. It now takes either name.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw on an unset flag. Unset now means off, as before.

The 8 warnings are hardcoded strings inside `build.js`. Nothing behind them to fix.
